markdown:
## Source and freshness

No live 2026 injury/practice feed exists. `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` still raises `ValueError: Season must be between 2009 and 2025` as of this run (19:25 UTC, 2026-09-05); Sleeper, ESPN and Rotowire remain proxy-blocked. This is expected, not a failure: week 1's first game is Wednesday 9/9 and the rest of the slate is Sunday 9/13/Monday 9/14, so real practice-participation reports for most of the roster won't exist until the Wed/Thu of that game week.

Fell back to the committed fixture `frontend/public/mock/league-2/weekly-report-week-1.json`, regenerated **2026-09-05T18:59:51Z** (commit `005ee57`). Sanity-checked before trusting it: designations across the 15 rostered players are genuinely mixed (11 Healthy, 4 Questionable-or-flagged... actually 3 Questionable: Higgins, Dicker, Downs), and `playProbability` spans 0.52-1.00 across 8 distinct values rather than one value per designation bucket. This matches the same fixture read by this morning's 08:11 Budapest run for this same slug -- every rostered player's expected points, conditional points and P(play) came out byte-identical despite the file being regenerated at a later timestamp. **Nothing has changed since this morning.**

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected pts | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Jaxson Dart | @DAL | 17.98 | 94.0% | 19.14 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs BAL | 17.02 | 90.5% | 18.80 |
| RB | Cam Skattebo | @DAL | 13.73 | 90.5% | 15.17 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | vs NE (Wed) | 18.07 | 93.6% | 19.30 |
| WR | Drake London | @PIT | 13.52 | 93.6% | 14.44 |
| TE | Brock Bowers | vs MIA | 13.63 | 89.6% | 15.21 |
| FLEX | Bucky Irving | @CIN | 12.29 | 90.5% | 13.58 |
| FLEX | Jameson Williams | vs NO | 9.29 | 78.7% | 11.81 |
| K | Cameron Dicker | vs ARI | 7.22 | 90.3% | 7.99 |
| DEF | Eagles D/ST | vs WAS | 6.99 | 100% | 6.99 |
| **Total** | | | **129.74** | | |

Bench (in expected-points order): Harold Fannin Jr. TE (9.25), Quentin Johnston WR (8.38), Tee Higgins WR (8.12), Josh Downs WR (4.88), Matthew Stafford QB (15.95, no usable slot behind Dart).

One real decision on the board: **start Jameson Williams over Tee Higgins at the second FLEX.** Higgins is Questionable at 52% to play; even his big if-he-plays number (15.62) doesn't clear the bar once that probability is applied (expected 8.12 vs Williams' 9.29 at 79% to play). Everyone else picks itself -- the rest of the lineup is Healthy players ranked by expected points with no position-minimum conflicts.

## Changes since this morning's briefing

None. This is a re-run of today's Saturday slot (fired manually at 19:24 UTC rather than the scheduled 08:00 Budapest time); the fixture was regenerated in between but every rostered player's numbers held exactly steady. The one standing lineup call -- bench Higgins, start Jameson Williams -- is unchanged from this morning.

## Watch list

| Player | Why | News due |
|---|---|---|
| Tee Higgins | Questionable, 52% to play. The one lineup call hinges on this. | First practice report ~Wed/Thu, final designation Fri 9/11 |
| Cameron Dicker | Questionable but 90% to play -- low real risk | Final designation Fri 9/11 |
| Josh Downs | Questionable, 52% to play -- bench WR, watch in case he becomes FLEX-viable | Final designation Fri 9/11 |

## Opponent notes

Jaxon Smith-Njigba's game (SEA vs NE) is the Wednesday 9/9 season opener -- it locks days before the rest of the roster's Sunday/Monday games. Set that WR slot early rather than waiting for the Friday designation wave that governs everyone else.

## Byes ahead

No rostered player has a bye in the next two weeks (weeks 1-3) -- the whole roster is clear through week 5. First cluster to plan for: **week 6** (Tee Higgins and Jameson Williams both -- worth flagging now since Higgins is on the bench today but shares Williams' bye week if he's rostered back in before then) and **week 7** (Cameron Dicker, the only K, and Quentin Johnston). With 5 bench spots, the K bye in week 7 is the one that will force a waiver streamer since there's no backup kicker on the roster.

## Caveats

- No live 2026 injury/practice feed available; all figures come from the committed fixture's own availability-model output, not a fresh model call this session.
- Week 1 kickoff is 4-8 days out -- this is a stable pre-season read, not a game-week final-call read despite it being a "Saturday" slot.
- This run duplicates today's earlier 08:11 Budapest briefing under the same slug (by design -- slug is date+kind only) and confirms it rather than revising it, except for adding Tee Higgins to the week-6 byes-ahead list, which the earlier version omitted.
